description_en: Updates the HTTP trigger configuration for a cloud function
description_zh: 更新云函数的HTTP触发配置
name: UpdateHttpTriggerConfig

parameters.help_en:
Sets whether to enable the HTTP trigger feature. Values:

true: Enables the HTTP trigger feature.

false: Disables the HTTP trigger feature
parameters.help_zh:
设置是否开启HTTP触发功能。取值：

true：表示开启HTTP触发功能。
false：表示关闭HTTP触发功能
parameters.name: enable_service

parameters.help_en:
Custom domain name. If you do not pass this field, the custom domain name is not updated. If you set it to an empty string, the custom domain name is deleted.

Before binding a custom domain name, your domain name must have an Alibaba Cloud ICP filing and a CNAME record configured to CustomDomainCname
parameters.help_zh:
自定义域名。不传该字段表示不更新自定义域名，设置为空字符串表示删除自定义域名。

在绑定自定义域名前，要求您的域名已经接入阿里云备案，并且已配置解析CNAME到CustomDomainCname
parameters.name: custom_domain

parameters.help_en: The HTTPS certificate for the custom domain name. Use this with CustomDomainPrivateKey. If you do not pass these two fields, the certificate is not updated. If you pass empty strings for both, the certificate is deleted
parameters.help_zh: 自定义域名的HTTPS证书。必须和CustomDomainPrivateKey一起使用，不传这两个字段表示不更新证书，都传空字符串表示删除证书
parameters.name: custom_domain_certificate

parameters.help_en: The private key for the custom domain name's HTTPS certificate. Use this with CustomDomainCertificate. If you do not pass these two fields, the certificate is not updated. If you pass empty strings for both, the certificate is deleted
parameters.help_zh: 自定义域名的HTTPS证书的私钥。必须和CustomDomainCertificate一起使用，不传这两个字段表示不更新证书，都传空字符串表示删除证书
parameters.name: custom_domain_private_key

CustomDomain.description_en: The custom domain name bound to the HTTP trigger
CustomDomain.description_zh: HTTP触发绑定的自定义域名

CustomDomainCertificateInfo.description_en: The certificate information for the custom domain name bound to the HTTP trigger
CustomDomainCertificateInfo.description_zh: HTTP触发绑定的自定义域名的证书信息

CustomDomainCname.description_en: The CNAME address of the custom domain name bound to the HTTP trigger
CustomDomainCname.description_zh: HTTP触发绑定的自定义域名的CNAME地址

DefaultEndpoint.description_en: The default domain name for the HTTP trigger

EnableService.description_en: Indicates whether the HTTP trigger feature is enabled
